Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION: STERNUM SAW (ELECTRICAL) Electric Sternal Saw: Should comprise of the following parts 1. Driving Unit (Motor with MCB and Foot Control) It should work with a power supply of 220~230V AC It should be completely enclosed It should have a Foot control for ON/OFF and speed It should be mounted on a pole/ stand with Castors for easy mobility It should be able to easily dismantled and packed in a suitcase 2. Flexible Shaft It should have a Minimum length 1.5 to 2 mtrs It should be autoclavable It should have Push-Pull type ends 3. Sternal Saw Hand piece - for primary sternotomy It should be Reciprocating blade type It should be compatible with both adult and pediatric patients It should be autoclavable. It should be light weight. It should have foot control. It should be provided with Set of 20 blades It should have provided two sets of tools and silicon oil. It should have provided two sterilization trays for autoclave. It should have two shaft cables. 1. Warranty-Five years with all spare parts and CMC, price may be quote on annual basis for another 5 yea rs with all spare parts. 2. The price of consumable blade and shaft cable which is not covered under warranty/CMC is to be quoted separately and price may be freeze for five years. .
